correctness.rationale: Genuine degree-four Lagrange interpolation at varying time nodes yields α0=sum(1/dj)>0 and the 3×3 difference companion first row of cumulative α2..α4. Four matrices give cubic z³-A(t)z²/D(t)+B(t)z/D(t)-C(t)/D(t), t=r+1/r≥2. Independent SymPy computation from interpolation agreed exactly for r=1/7,1/2,1,3/2,3,9 (not alone an all-r certificate). Rescaling by sqrt(21) and cubic Schur criterion reduces strict root bound to P1,P2,P3 shifted coefficient positivity with 4<sqrt21<5 and positive-coefficient polynomial P4; independently rechecked all these polynomial coefficient certificates. As t→∞ the limiting cubic z(z²-2z/15+1/21) has conjugate roots modulus 1/sqrt21, establishing sharpness and nonattainment at finite r. Does not prove arbitrary-step norm stability.
residual_risks: Algebraic finite checks do not alone establish infinite theorems; analytical proof independently reconstructed.
